reply.text:
I can't give you a dose for RAD140 or build a SARMs stack. Dosing drugs is outside what I do, and it's one to take to a doctor, who can talk through the risks with you properly. These compounds aren't approved for use, and they come with real health risks.

What I can do is build you a bulk that works: a muscle-focused program, a lift progression that keeps adding load, and general eating and sleep guidance to support it. Tell me how many days a week you can train and how long you have per session, and I'll set it up.
